summary: Applied three blocking spec-review repairs: task-impl parity, observable implement completion evidence, and spec-review source finding extraction.

items.title: Disambiguate impl-gate phases
items.rationale: Added task-impl as an explicit retained impl-gate phase wherever R6/R7 describe retry exhaustion or migration parity.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R6/R7 and acceptance criteria now include both task-impl and integration gate phases.

items.title: Define lint readiness evidence for implement completion
items.rationale: Removed lint readiness from R4/T-3 completion requirements because no durable lint evidence path exists in the current flow artifacts.
items.evidence: spec.json R4, R4 acceptance criteria, and T-3 now require only observable requirement status, file-map coverage, and durable artifact evidence.

items.title: Specify spec-review source finding extraction
items.rationale: Specified that spec-review deferral reads semantic blocking records from actual spec-review.json source arrays and preserves or synthesizes stable sourceFindingId values.
items.evidence: spec.json R6, R6 acceptance criteria, overview decisions, and T-4 acceptance now name spec-review.json source finding extraction.
